recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 可見混合型發炎背景（小淋巴球、上皮樣組織球），黃圈內為多個細胞核聚成葡萄串狀的多核巨細胞（Warthin-Finkeldey-like cells），紅圈內為雙核、核仁明顯的 Reed-Sternberg 細胞；在混合背景中找到 RS 細胞才是 cHL 的依據。
features: Diffuse polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes and abundant epithelioid histiocytes with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Multinucleated giant cells with clustered, overlapping grape-like nuclei (Warthin-Finkeldey-like cells, yellow circles)
Binucleate/multilobated large cell with prominent nucleoli (Reed-Sternberg cell, red circle)
Scattered larger mononuclear cells with vesicular nuclei
No sheets of large atypical cells; lymph node architecture effaced in this field
describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement by a diffuse polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes and numerous epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Scattered multinucleated giant cells with clustered, overlapping grape-like nuclei resembling Warthin-Finkeldey cells are present (yellow circles). A binucleate large cell with prominent nucleoli, consistent with a Reed-Sternberg cell, is identified in the background (red circle). Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma with Warthin-Finkeldey-like polykaryocytes; immunohistochemistry (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45-) is needed to confirm the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells.

ddx.vs: Shows follicular hyperplasia with polykaryocytes but lacks CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and has a relevant viral history.
Langhans-type giant cells with peripheral horseshoe nuclei and epithelioid granulomas, without Reed-Sternberg cells.
Scattered large cells are CD20+/BCL6+ and CD30/CD15 negative in a T-cell and histiocyte-rich background.
Hallmark cells grow in cohesive sheets or sinusoidal clusters with strong uniform CD30 and often ALK positivity.
